name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.leafView_close_succinct
title: The leaf view with Def_SuccinctLWE's own setup kernel: real vs simulated within 2x LHL
statement: leafView_close_zmod instantiated with the setup kernel of Def_SuccinctLWE (W uniform, split into its l row blocks, T <- trapdoorLaw p B W), the public check 'T exists and its entries are at most E_T', the blocks T_B[i,j], T_W[j] of T, and any gadget Gamma with Gamma.G = gadget n k q: the real leaf view (attribute 0) and the simulated view (attribute w with phi(0) = phi(w) = 0) are within 2 * m sqrt(q^n / 2^m)/2. The block identity B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G is proved on the support of trapdoorLaw.
